resources.string: Devices registered to your subscription, not live connections. Anyone with your subscription link can manage this list. Keep the link private.
Add your Filvless subscription on the home screen first. Device management supports subscriptions from sub.prostobotyg.ru.
Device access is not enabled on the service yet. Contact support; the subscription itself is unchanged.
The subscription is unavailable or has changed. Refresh it on the home screen.
Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.
This device is no longer in the list. Refresh the devices.
Could not load devices. Check your connection and try again. If a removal was interrupted, refresh the list to check its result.
No registered devices yet. They appear after the subscription is added on a device.
Remove “%1$s” from the subscription device list? This does not revoke previously downloaded connection settings. A device with the subscription link can register again.
